reviewNotes: Source contract fields are matched for presence, optionality and explicit nullability; this is not runtime or production validation.
Person and LearnerProfile countryCode coexist in source: semantic equivalence, ownership and compatibility unresolved; no new duplicate authority approved.
Target type and lifecycle mapping for Enrollment remain draft; existing status strings are not a final canonical lifecycle or allowed transition graph.
Target types, classifications, path candidates, commands and policies are design proposals; no runtime dependency.
Shared identity audit fields are inherited source fields; qualified item IDs for their reusable field group and nested members deferred pending namespace review.

D01 extends the catalogue with ten permanent profile/evidence/projection concepts documented by the existing Wave 1 migration contract and a proposed HouseholdMembership record. Historical migration evidence is not current live coverage. New profile fields and field-set bindings remain unallocated; preserve the existing profile contract.

Household membership is not evidence of guardianship, billing responsibility, consent or application access. Household membership candidate path requires collision/dependency review; no automatic historical backfill.

M01 design additions are proposed target fields, not verified source fields. Academic nested keys are contextual; organisation/year/grade/section references require explicit school-to-organisation binding and parent path resolution. No bare local ID accepted as a global key.
ENR-1004 preserves prior item ID but target value set is unresolved: source interface omits operational trial/paused/discontinued/completed and aliases. No implicit normalization or schema adoption.

TEN/ORG scope fields and paths are proposed, not a permission grant. ContextualRoleGrant remains an alternative only; ROL authority retained. Catalogue visibility/tenant sharing and exact scope field contract require review.

Final M01 cross-check: DLV has explicit tenant ownership; root programme/course/skill catalogue has explicit platformShared or tenantOwned scope. Curriculum and nested units inherit verified course scope; PCM and USK require compatible source/target catalogue scope. Scope fields are design proposals and not new required fields on current production data.

M02 adds proposed target fields, not source-backed field verification. Retain existing classSessions IDs, online IST calendar claims and source status/finance behavior. No reactivation of automatic session creation. Session participant/staff, official attendance, AVS evidence and financial events are separate facts.

SCP recurrence structure, SES lifecycle/status and finance snapshot, ACR changes, assessment results/rubric and projection fields require typed shapes and mapping before adoption. Nested contextual keys resolve via parent scope; no bare local ID is globally unique. Existing raw status and prior item IDs preserved.

All new tenant-owned roots require scope checks; catalogue definition visibility follows M01. Provider/recording references are restricted, never independent entitlements. Existing parentClassRecordings/OneDrive mapping and external provider permission require D10 review. School attendance status is a separate proposed policy, not online billing.
